PHOTO_GUIDE.OPEN: How do I take professional photos?
PHOTO_GUIDE.TITLE: How to take better photos
PHOTO_GUIDE.SUBTITLE: Quick guide — 30 seconds
PHOTO_GUIDE.READY_TITLE: Ready? Let’s get the best photo first
PHOTO_GUIDE.ENCOURAGE: A clear photo helps people stop at your listing. Here are the key tips before you start:

INTRO.sale: For sale: show the size, condition and finish as they really are — buyers compare many listings.
INTRO.rent: For rent: focus on the rooms, kitchen, bathroom and condition — the first things a tenant asks about.
INTRO.shortStay: For short stays: guests decide from the photos, so show the bed, kitchen, bathroom and comforts.

KIND_TIP.sale: Photograph any visible flaw honestly; being open avoids surprises at the viewing.
KIND_TIP.rent: Show the fittings that are included (water heater, kitchen, wardrobes) so tenants know what they get.
KIND_TIP.shortStay: Show the comforts you mention in the listing: air conditioning, kitchen, balcony…

TIPS.LIGHT: Use natural light: open the curtains and windows.
TIPS.TIDY: Tidy up first: remove personal items and clutter.
TIPS.STEADY: Hold the phone horizontally and steady — rest your elbows if you can.
TIPS.HONEST: Show the real space; avoid misleading angles.
TIPS.DETAILS: Capture the important details instead of repeating the same shot.
TIPS.LENS: Wipe your phone lens before you start.
TIPS.SHARP: Avoid dark or blurry photos; retake the shot if needed.
TIPS.FRESH: Use recent photos only; if the property changed, update them.

FACADE.TITLE: Building front
FACADE.WHAT: The whole building from the street, including the entrance.
FACADE.WHY: It is the first photo people see and hints at the building and the area.
FACADE.HOW: Stand across the street in daylight with the sun behind you, phone horizontal at chest height.

LIVING.TITLE: Living room
LIVING.WHAT: The room from a corner so the most floor space shows.
LIVING.WHY: People want to picture themselves in it and know its real size.
LIVING.HOW: Stand in a corner, open the curtains and tidy loose items first.

BEDROOM.TITLE: Bedroom
BEDROOM.WHAT: The bed, wardrobe and window in one shot.
BEDROOM.WHY: It shows how much space there really is and how light gets in.
BEDROOM.HOW: Shoot from the door or a corner, make the bed and use daylight.

KITCHEN.TITLE: Kitchen
KITCHEN.WHAT: The cabinets, sink and cooker area.
KITCHEN.WHY: The kitchen is one of the things people ask about most.
KITCHEN.HOW: Clear the counters, clean the sink and shoot from a corner to show it all.

BATHROOM.TITLE: Bathroom
BATHROOM.WHAT: The whole bathroom: basin, shower and tiles.
BATHROOM.WHY: Cleanliness here builds a lot of trust.
BATHROOM.HOW: Close the toilet lid, hide personal items and wipe the mirror so you are not reflected.

BALCONY.TITLE: Balcony and view
BALCONY.WHAT: The balcony and what you can see from it: street, mountain or neighbourhood.
BALCONY.WHY: A view is a real advantage and deserves to be seen.
BALCONY.HOW: Shoot in daylight with a straight horizon; don’t pinch-zoom — walk closer or back.

COURTYARD.TITLE: Garden, courtyard or roof
COURTYARD.WHAT: The open space as it is, with its best feature.
COURTYARD.WHY: Outdoor space is rare and sets a property apart.
COURTYARD.HOW: Take one wide shot showing the boundaries and one close shot of the best detail, like a fountain or tree.

ENTRANCE.TITLE: Entrance
ENTRANCE.WHAT: The door and the entrance of the building or flat.
ENTRANCE.WHY: Guests want to know where they will walk in and that it is tidy and safe.
ENTRANCE.HOW: Shoot the door straight on in daylight and avoid showing neighbours’ names or numbers.

PROBLEM_SOLUTION.DESC: We hear the same complaints every day. HudhudNest aims to fix them, step by step.

PROBLEM_ITEMS.ITEM_2: Hard to tell if a listing is real or a duplicate
PROBLEM_ITEMS.ITEM_3: Most listings are missing photos and basic information
PROBLEM_ITEMS.ITEM_4: Hard to compare prices and areas in one place
PROBLEM_ITEMS.ITEM_5: Weak trust between the seeker and the owner or agency

SOLUTION_ITEMS.ITEM_1: One platform that brings together Syria's listings, organized and searchable
SOLUTION_ITEMS.ITEM_2: Clear photos and consistent basic information on every listing
SOLUTION_ITEMS.ITEM_3: Filter by city, area, price, type, and purpose
SOLUTION_ITEMS.ITEM_4: Direct contact with the owner or real-estate office
SOLUTION_ITEMS.ITEM_5: Gradual verification to reduce noise and increase transparency

FEATURES.TITLE: Everything you need in one place

SEARCH.TITLE: Easier search
SEARCH.DESC: Filter by city, area, price, property type, and purpose — for sale or rent — in seconds.

INFO.TITLE: Clearer information
INFO.DESC: Photos, a detailed description, approximate location, size, floors, and organized contact details — everything in its place.

CONTACT.TITLE: Direct contact
CONTACT.DESC: Reach the owner or real-estate office directly, with no complicated steps or unnecessary middlemen.

SCALE.TITLE: Built to grow
SCALE.DESC: We're starting in Syria, serving major cities and expats, with a design built to expand into Arab and global markets.

STEP_1.TITLE: Choose a property type or city
STEP_1.DESC: Decide whether you're looking to rent or buy, then choose your preferred city or area.

STEP_2.TITLE: Browse organized listings
STEP_2.DESC: Explore properties with clear photos, prices, and information, and compare options easily.

STEP_3.TITLE: Contact or join the waitlist
STEP_3.DESC: Reach out directly to the listing owner, or join the waitlist now to be the first notified at launch.

FORM.TITLE: Be one of the first HudhudNest users
FORM.DESC: Register your interest now and we'll reach out when the platform launches in your area.

SUCCESS.OFFER_MSG: Great! We've reserved you a spot in the "first 100 offices" offer. We'll follow up soon with the details.
SUCCESS.NO_OFFER_MSG: Unfortunately the limited offer filled up before your registration arrived, but your interest has been registered — we'll reach out when the platform launches.
SUCCESS.PLAIN_MSG: Thank you — your interest has been registered. We'll send you updates when HudhudNest launches.

USER_TYPES.OWNER: I want to list a property

FORM.NOTES_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Looking for a 2-bedroom apartment in Mazzeh under $200
FORM.PRIVACY_NOTE: We won't share your data with third parties or send unsolicited messages.

TRUST.TITLE: We're building trust step by step
TRUST.DESC: We're in our first MVP stage. Here's what we commit to, and what's still in progress.

PHOTOS.TITLE: Real photos required
PHOTOS.DESC: We encourage property owners to upload real photos of the property, and don't accept fake or borrowed images.

CONTACT.TITLE: Clear contact details
CONTACT.DESC: Every listing must include accurate contact information. We're here to connect you with the other side.

CAUTION.TITLE: Don't pay before verifying
CAUTION.DESC: We always recommend visiting the property in person and verifying documents before paying anything. The platform facilitates contact — it doesn't guarantee the deal.

IMPROVING.TITLE: Always improving
IMPROVING.DESC: Listing verification will keep improving over time. We're upfront about being in an early stage.

LAUNCH.A: We're currently building the MVP. Waitlist members will be the first to receive a launch invite.

FREE.Q: Is the service free at first?
FREE.A: Yes — we plan for the service to be free in its first stage for both seekers and property owners, with the possibility of premium plans later.

OWNER.A: Absolutely. Register your interest through the form and choose "I want to list a property" — we'll reach out once listing opens.

AGENCY.Q: Can real-estate offices add their listings?
AGENCY.A: Yes, we welcome real-estate offices. Choose "Real-estate office" in the form and we'll follow up with partnership details.

VERIFIED.Q: Are the listings verified and safe?
VERIFIED.A: We're working on clearer information and fewer random listings. The platform is still in development, and verification will keep improving. As with any real-estate deal, we always recommend verifying in person before deciding.

SYRIA_ONLY.Q: Is the platform only for Syria?
SYRIA_ONLY.A: We're starting in Syria, but the design supports expanding into Arab and global markets later, especially to serve Syrian expats everywhere.

FINAL_CTA.TITLE: Be one of the first HudhudNest users
FINAL_CTA.DESC: Help us build a more organized real-estate experience in Syria. Your voice will help shape the platform to come.

FOOTER.TAGLINE: A digital real-estate platform · Syria first

OFFER_SHARE.TITLE: Prepare the offer for sharing
OFFER_SHARE.HONESTY: These are preparation and sharing tools: they open a platform dialog or copy the text, and publish nothing by themselves. Direct publishing through connected accounts exists for property listings only (the “Social distribution” tab). The link opens the landing page, which shows the offer that is live at the time of the visit.
OFFER_SHARE.NOT_VISIBLE: An offer that visitors cannot see (draft, paused, ended, not started yet, or fully redeemed) cannot be shared. Activate it and make sure it is visible first.
OFFER_SHARE.DIALOG_OPENED: The share dialog was opened. Nothing has been published yet — a post only exists once you confirm it inside the platform.
OFFER_SHARE.ERROR_BUILD: Could not prepare the share text. Please try again.
